summary: Inspected all 3 changed/added files in the Hasse-Weil project. Each contains substantial formal mathematical content: EllipticDivisibilitySequence.lean develops the theory of normalized elliptic divisibility sequences with relations, invariants, universal constructions, and extensionality; FrobeniusFixedLocus.lean proves the fundamental Frobenius fixed-point criterion for finite fields (image of K equals roots of X^q−X); VerschiebungFactorization.lean contains the core middle spines of the Hasse-Weil proof including the Verschiebung dual existence, separable degree = point count, kernel-degree skeleton, embedding↔kernel classification, genuine isogeny theory, and signed quadratic-form degree identities. All files contain definitions, lemmas, theorems, and proofs — no pure import aggregators or content-free files. Per FILTER-002/FILTER-004, hard exclusion requires a content-level reason to believe no unique searchable formal mathematics is lost; these files are core mathematical content.
